items.text: Kansas City (Wednesday report): QB Patrick Mahomes (right elbow/knee) FULL participant, on track to start. DNP - RT Jaylon Moore (ankle), DT Peter Woods (neck). Limited - DT Omarr Norman-Lott (knee). Full - WR Xavier Worthy (hamstring), CB Mansoor Delane (shoulder), TE Travis Kelce (ankle), WR Rashee Rice (knee), S Jaden Hicks (shoulder), LB Jeff Bassa (hand), QB Justin Fields (neck). IR - WR Tyquan Thornton, CB L'Jarius Sneed, LT Josh Simmons (eligible Wk11). Thursday report not yet found. Mahomes starts.
